summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K reporting the results of Rentokil Initial plc's 2026 Annual General Meeting. All resolutions were passed, including director elections, auditor reappointment, dividend declaration, share plan approval, and authorities to allot shares. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer on SEC Form 6-K relating to an ordinary shareholder meeting.
